A1.speaker: COCO
A1.text: Good morning. Are you looking for the museum?

A1.speaker: YOU
A1.text: Yes. I want to visit it today.

A1.speaker: COCO
A1.text: I can help you find the way.

A1.speaker: YOU
A1.text: Thank you. I am new here.

A1.speaker: COCO
A1.text: Do you have a map on your phone?

A1.speaker: YOU
A1.text: Yes, but I cannot find the entrance.

A1.speaker: COCO
A1.text: The museum has two entrances.

A1.speaker: YOU
A1.text: Which one is closer to us?
A1.zh: 哪個入口離我們比較近？

A1.speaker: COCO
A1.text: The east entrance is closer.

A1.speaker: YOU
A1.text: Can we walk there?

A1.speaker: COCO
A1.text: Yes, but it takes twenty minutes.

A1.speaker: YOU
A1.text: That may be a little long.

A1.speaker: COCO
A1.text: We can take a bus instead.

A1.speaker: YOU
A1.text: That sounds good. Where is the stop?
A1.zh: 聽起來不錯。站牌在哪裡？

A1.speaker: COCO
A1.text: It is across this square.
A1.zh: 就在這個廣場的另一側。

A1.speaker: YOU
A1.text: Let us go to the stop.

A1.speaker: COCO
A1.text: First, walk past the fountain.

A1.speaker: YOU
A1.text: I see it near the trees.

A1.speaker: COCO
A1.text: Then turn right at the bookstore.

A1.speaker: YOU
A1.text: Is that the small blue store?

A1.speaker: COCO
A1.text: Yes. The bus stop is beside it.

A1.speaker: YOU
A1.text: I can see a sign there.

A1.speaker: COCO
A1.text: Let us check the bus number.

A1.speaker: YOU
A1.text: The sign says number twelve.

A1.speaker: COCO
A1.text: That is the right bus.

A1.speaker: YOU
A1.text: How often does it come?

A1.speaker: COCO
A1.text: It comes every ten minutes.

A1.speaker: YOU
A1.text: We have time to buy a ticket.

A1.speaker: COCO
A1.text: There is a ticket machine here.

A1.speaker: YOU
A1.text: Can I pay with my card?

A1.speaker: COCO
A1.text: Yes. Choose one adult ticket.

A1.speaker: YOU
A1.text: The screen asks for a destination.

A1.speaker: COCO
A1.text: Choose Museum East.

A1.speaker: YOU
A1.text: I found it. Is this the right price?

A1.speaker: COCO
A1.text: Yes, that is the bus fare.

A1.speaker: YOU
A1.text: I have my ticket now.

A1.speaker: COCO
A1.text: Here comes the bus.

A1.speaker: YOU
A1.text: Does the front sign say Museum East?
A1.zh: 車頭是不是寫「博物館東側」？

A1.speaker: COCO
A1.text: Yes. Let us get on.

A1.speaker: YOU
A1.text: Do I show my ticket to the driver?

A1.speaker: COCO
A1.text: Just tap it on this reader.
A1.zh: 只要在這個感應器上刷一下。

A1.speaker: YOU
A1.text: The light is green. Did it work?

A1.speaker: COCO
A1.text: Yes. We can sit near the window.

A1.speaker: YOU
A1.text: How many stops do we have?

A1.speaker: COCO
A1.text: Usually, we get off after four stops.

A1.speaker: YOU
A1.text: Please tell me when we are close.

A1.speaker: COCO
A1.text: Of course. I will watch the signs.

A1.speaker: YOU
A1.text: The bus is turning left now.

A1.speaker: COCO
A1.text: Is this still the right way?

A1.speaker: YOU
A1.text: Yes. There is a small road change today.
A1.zh: 對。今天路線有一點調整。

A1.speaker: COCO
A1.text: Why did the route change?

A1.speaker: YOU
A1.text: There is work on the main street.

A1.speaker: COCO
A1.text: Will we be late?

A1.speaker: YOU
A1.text: No. The change only adds a few minutes.

A1.speaker: COCO
A1.text: That is good. What stop is next?
A1.zh: 那就好。下一站是哪一站？

A1.speaker: YOU
A1.text: The next stop is Central Park.

A1.speaker: COCO
A1.text: Can we see the park from here?

A1.speaker: YOU
A1.text: Yes. It is on your left.

A1.speaker: COCO
A1.text: It looks like a nice place.
A1.zh: 看起來是個不錯的地方。

A1.speaker: YOU
A1.text: We can visit after the museum.
A1.zh: 參觀完博物館後可以來走走。

A1.speaker: COCO
A1.text: I would like that.

A1.speaker: YOU
A1.text: Now we are two stops away.

A1.speaker: COCO
A1.text: Should I press the stop button?

A1.speaker: YOU
A1.text: Not yet. Press it after the next stop.
A1.zh: 還不用。過下一站後再按。

A1.speaker: COCO
A1.text: Okay. I will wait.

A1.speaker: YOU
A1.text: The next stop has passed.

A1.speaker: COCO
A1.text: I will press the button now.

A1.speaker: YOU
A1.text: Great. Our stop is coming.

A1.speaker: COCO
A1.text: I can see the museum sign.
A1.zh: 我看到博物館的指標了。

A1.speaker: YOU
A1.text: Let us get off at this stop.

A1.speaker: COCO
A1.text: Which way do we go now?

A1.speaker: YOU
A1.text: Walk toward the large clock.

A1.speaker: COCO
A1.text: Is the clock beside the garden?

A1.speaker: YOU
A1.text: Yes. The path starts there.

A1.speaker: COCO
A1.text: I see two paths. Which one is ours?
A1.zh: 我看到兩條路。我們要走哪條？

A1.speaker: YOU
A1.text: Take the path on the right.

A1.speaker: COCO
A1.text: There is a bridge ahead.

A1.speaker: YOU
A1.text: Cross it, then follow the green signs.
A1.zh: 過橋後沿著綠色指標走。

A1.speaker: COCO
A1.text: The signs point to the east entrance.

A1.speaker: YOU
A1.text: That is the entrance we need.
A1.zh: 那正是我們要去的入口。

A1.speaker: COCO
A1.text: Is the ticket desk inside?

A1.speaker: YOU
A1.text: Yes, just behind the doors.

A1.speaker: COCO
A1.text: What time does the museum open?

A1.speaker: YOU
A1.text: It opens at ten in the morning.

A1.speaker: COCO
A1.text: It is almost ten now.

A1.speaker: YOU
A1.text: We arrived at a good time.

A1.speaker: COCO
A1.text: Can I buy a tour ticket here?
A1.zh: 我可以在這裡買導覽票嗎？

A1.speaker: YOU
A1.text: Yes. Ask at the desk on the left.

A1.speaker: COCO
A1.text: I will ask about the next tour.

A1.speaker: YOU
A1.text: I can wait near the entrance.
A1.zh: 我可以在入口附近等你。

A1.speaker: COCO
A1.text: The next tour starts at eleven.
A1.zh: 下一場導覽十一點開始。

A1.speaker: YOU
A1.text: That gives us time to look around.
A1.zh: 那我們還有時間四處看看。

A1.speaker: COCO
A1.text: There is a map of the museum here.

A1.speaker: YOU
A1.text: Can you show me the meeting point?
A1.zh: 可以指給我看集合地點嗎？

A1.speaker: COCO
A1.text: It is in the main hall.

A1.speaker: YOU
A1.text: Thank you. I know the way now.
A1.zh: 謝謝你。我現在知道怎麼走了。

A1.speaker: COCO
A1.text: You are welcome. Enjoy the museum!

A1.speaker: YOU
A1.text: I will. Thanks for your help today.
A1.zh: 一定會的。謝謝你今天的幫忙。

A2.speaker: COCO
A2.text: Excuse me, are you looking for the city museum?
A2.zh: 不好意思，你在找市立博物館嗎？

A2.speaker: YOU
A2.text: Yes, I am. Can I walk there from here?
A2.zh: 對，請問從這裡可以走過去嗎？

A2.speaker: COCO
A2.text: Yes. Go straight for two blocks, then turn right.
A2.zh: 可以。直走兩個街區，然後右轉。

A2.speaker: YOU
A2.text: Great. Is there a sign near the entrance?
A2.zh: 太好了。入口附近有標示嗎？

A3.speaker: COCO
A3.text: The museum opens at ten. When would you like to arrive?
A3.zh: 博物館十點開門。你想幾點到？

A3.speaker: YOU
A3.text: I would like to get there before noon. Which bus should I take?
A3.zh: 我想在中午前到。應該搭哪班公車？

A3.speaker: COCO
A3.text: Take bus twelve and get off after three stops.
A3.zh: 搭十二號公車，三站後下車。

A3.speaker: YOU
A3.text: Thanks. How often does that bus come?
A3.zh: 謝謝。那班公車多久來一班？

B1.speaker: COCO
B1.text: The direct train is delayed, but there is another route through Central Station.
B1.zh: 直達列車誤點了，但可以從中央車站轉乘其他路線。

B1.speaker: YOU
B1.text: I need to reach the museum by one because my tour starts then.
B1.zh: 我得在一點前抵達博物館，因為導覽那時開始。

B1.speaker: COCO
B1.text: In that case, take the green line and change at Central Station.
B1.zh: 這樣的話，搭綠線並在中央車站轉車。

B1.speaker: YOU
B1.text: How long will the whole trip take with the transfer?
B1.zh: 加上轉乘，整趟大概需要多久？

B2.speaker: COCO
B2.text: You can take the bus or walk along the river; both routes reach the gallery.
B2.zh: 你可以搭公車或沿著河邊走，兩條路都能到美術館。

B2.speaker: YOU
B2.text: If I walk, will I still arrive before the guided tour begins?
B2.zh: 如果用走的，還趕得上導覽開始嗎？

B2.speaker: COCO
B2.text: Probably, provided you leave now and use the pedestrian bridge.
B2.zh: 應該可以，前提是你現在出發並走行人天橋。

B2.speaker: YOU
B2.text: I would rather walk. Could you point out the bridge on this map?
B2.zh: 我比較想走路。可以在地圖上指出天橋的位置嗎？

B3.speaker: COCO
B3.text: Roadworks have closed the usual entrance, so the map on your phone is out of date.
B3.zh: 道路施工讓原本的入口封閉了，因此你手機上的地圖資訊已過時。

B3.speaker: YOU
B3.text: I have limited time. Is there an accessible entrance that avoids the stairs?
B3.zh: 我時間不多。有沒有不用走樓梯的無障礙入口？

B3.speaker: COCO
B3.text: Yes, but you will need to circle the block and enter from the east side.
B3.zh: 有，但你需要繞過這個街區，從東側進入。

B3.speaker: YOU
B3.text: Could you describe the landmark beside it so I do not miss the turn?
B3.zh: 可以描述入口旁的地標嗎？我怕錯過轉彎處。

C1.speaker: COCO
C1.text: The fastest route is crowded at this hour, whereas the riverside route is calmer but less direct.
C1.zh: 這個時間最快的路線很擁擠；河岸路線比較清幽，但沒那麼直接。

C1.speaker: YOU
C1.text: I am happy to trade a few minutes for a quieter walk, provided the signs are easy to follow.
C1.zh: 如果指標清楚，我願意多花幾分鐘，換一段比較安靜的步行路線。

C1.speaker: COCO
C1.text: They are clear until the footbridge; after that, keep the old library on your left.
C1.zh: 到行人橋前指標都很清楚；過橋後讓舊圖書館保持在你的左手邊。

C1.speaker: YOU
C1.text: Let me check I have it right: I cross the bridge and continue past the library?
C1.zh: 我確認一下：過橋之後，繼續走過圖書館，對嗎？

C2.speaker: COCO
C2.text: The express bus looks quicker on paper, but traffic around the station can erase that advantage.
C2.zh: 快速公車表面上較快，但車站周邊的車流可能讓這個優勢消失。

C2.speaker: YOU
C2.text: Given that uncertainty, I would rather take the tram, even if it means one extra transfer.
C2.zh: 考量這項不確定性，即使需要多轉一次車，我也寧可搭電車。

C2.speaker: COCO
C2.text: That is sensible. Stay on until Harbor Square, then follow signs for the eastbound platform.
C2.zh: 這樣很合理。搭到港口廣場，再依指標走到東向月台。

C2.speaker: YOU
C2.text: Before I set off, could you clarify whether the same ticket covers both legs?
C2.zh: 出發前，能否確認同一張票是否涵蓋兩段車程？

C3.speaker: COCO
C3.text: A temporary closure has made the posted route misleading, and the alternative is poorly signposted after dusk.
C3.zh: 臨時封路讓張貼的路線資訊容易誤導人，入夜後替代路線的指標也不清楚。

C3.speaker: YOU
C3.text: Rather than risk a wrong turn, could you outline a route with clear landmarks, even if it takes longer?
C3.zh: 與其冒著走錯路的風險，能否說明一條地標明確的路線，即使比較遠也沒關係？

C3.speaker: COCO
C3.text: Follow the lit boulevard to the clock tower, cross at the signal, and keep the museum gardens on your right.
C3.zh: 沿著有照明的大道走到鐘樓，在號誌處過馬路，讓博物館花園保持在右手邊。

C3.speaker: YOU
C3.text: So I should ignore the old signs entirely and use the clock tower as my first checkpoint?
C3.zh: 所以我應該完全忽略舊指標，把鐘樓當作第一個確認點，對嗎？

A1.speaker: COCO
A1.text: Hi! What can I get for you today?

A1.speaker: YOU
A1.text: Could I have a small latte, please?
A1.zh: 可以給我一杯小杯拿鐵嗎？

A1.speaker: COCO
A1.text: Sure. Would you like it hot or iced?
A1.zh: 好的。你想喝熱的還是冰的？

A1.speaker: YOU
A1.text: Iced, please. Do you have oat milk?
A1.zh: 冰的，謝謝。你們有燕麥奶嗎？

A1.speaker: COCO
A1.text: Yes, we do. Anything else?

A1.speaker: YOU
A1.text: No, that's all. Thank you!

A2.speaker: COCO
A2.text: Good morning! Would you like something to drink?
A2.zh: 早安！你想喝點什麼嗎？

A2.speaker: YOU
A2.text: A medium latte, please. Can you make it iced?
A2.zh: 一杯中杯拿鐵，謝謝。可以做成冰的嗎？

A2.speaker: COCO
A2.text: Of course. Would you like regular or oat milk?
A2.zh: 當然可以。你要一般牛奶還是燕麥奶？

A2.speaker: YOU
A2.text: Oat milk, please. I will drink it here.
A2.zh: 燕麥奶，謝謝。我會在這裡喝。

A3.speaker: COCO
A3.text: Our breakfast set comes with coffee and a sandwich.
A3.zh: 我們的早餐套餐附咖啡和三明治。

A3.speaker: YOU
A3.text: Can I choose a decaf coffee with the set?
A3.zh: 套餐的咖啡可以選低咖啡因的嗎？

A3.speaker: COCO
A3.text: Yes. It will take about five minutes to prepare.
A3.zh: 可以。準備大約需要五分鐘。

A3.speaker: YOU
A3.text: That works. Please make the sandwich without cheese.
A3.zh: 可以。三明治請不要加起司。

B1.speaker: COCO
B1.text: We have two lunch specials today. One is vegetarian.
B1.zh: 今天有兩種午餐特餐，其中一種是素食。

B1.speaker: YOU
B1.text: I would prefer the vegetarian one because I do not eat meat.
B1.zh: 我比較想選素食的，因為我不吃肉。

B1.speaker: COCO
B1.text: It comes with soup, but you can swap that for a salad.
B1.zh: 套餐附湯，不過你可以換成沙拉。

B1.speaker: YOU
B1.text: Could I have the salad and a cup of tea instead?
B1.zh: 我可以換沙拉，再點一杯茶嗎？

B2.speaker: COCO
B2.text: The single-origin coffee has a fruity taste, while our house blend is milder.
B2.zh: 單一產區咖啡帶有果香，店內配方則比較溫和。

B2.speaker: YOU
B2.text: I usually prefer less acidity. Would the house blend suit me better?
B2.zh: 我通常喜歡酸度低一點的。店內配方會比較適合嗎？

B2.speaker: COCO
B2.text: I think so. We can also prepare it with milk if you prefer.
B2.zh: 我想是的。如果你喜歡，也可以加牛奶。

B2.speaker: YOU
B2.text: Please make it with milk, but keep the drink unsweetened.
B2.zh: 請加牛奶，但不要加糖。

B3.speaker: COCO
B3.text: We have run out of oat milk, although almond milk is still available.
B3.zh: 燕麥奶已經用完了，不過杏仁奶還有。

B3.speaker: YOU
B3.text: I have a nut allergy, so almond milk will not work for me.
B3.zh: 我對堅果過敏，所以不能用杏仁奶。

B3.speaker: COCO
B3.text: Thanks for telling me. We can use dairy milk or make the coffee black.
B3.zh: 謝謝你告訴我。我們可以用一般牛奶，或做成黑咖啡。

B3.speaker: YOU
B3.text: Please make it black, and could you check that the cup is clean?
B3.zh: 請做成黑咖啡，也麻煩確認杯子是乾淨的。

C1.speaker: COCO
C1.text: Our seasonal drink is quite sweet by default, but we can adjust the syrup.
C1.zh: 本季飲品預設偏甜，不過糖漿用量可以調整。

C1.speaker: YOU
C1.text: I would like to taste the coffee itself, so could you use just a little syrup?
C1.zh: 我想喝得出咖啡本身的味道，所以可以只加一點糖漿嗎？

C1.speaker: COCO
C1.text: Certainly. Half the usual amount would keep the flavor balanced.
C1.zh: 當然可以。用平常一半的量，風味應該會比較平衡。

C1.speaker: YOU
C1.text: That sounds right. Please make it to go, and label the cup as half sweet.
C1.zh: 聽起來剛好。請做成外帶，並在杯上標註半糖。

C2.speaker: COCO
C2.text: We can prepare your order now, although the kitchen is running about fifteen minutes behind.
C2.zh: 我們現在可以接單，但廚房的出餐時間大約延後十五分鐘。

C2.speaker: YOU
C2.text: I have a meeting shortly. Could we split the order so the coffee comes first?
C2.zh: 我很快就有會議。能否分開出餐，先給我咖啡？

C2.speaker: COCO
C2.text: Absolutely. I can bring the coffee now and pack the food when it is ready.
C2.zh: 當然。我可以現在先送咖啡，餐點做好後再打包。

C2.speaker: YOU
C2.text: That would be ideal; please let me know if the delay becomes any longer.
C2.zh: 這樣最好；如果等候時間又延長，請告訴我。

C3.speaker: COCO
C3.text: The menu describes this blend as mild, though its finish can taste sharper when served without milk.
C3.zh: 菜單將這款配方描述為溫和，但不加奶時，尾韻可能比較鮮明。

C3.speaker: YOU
C3.text: I am after a balanced drink rather than a sweet one; how would you adjust the preparation?
C3.zh: 我想喝的是平衡的風味，而不是甜味；你會怎麼調整做法？

C3.speaker: COCO
C3.text: I would pull a shorter shot, add a little steamed milk, and leave out the flavored syrup.
C3.zh: 我會縮短萃取、加少量蒸奶，並省略風味糖漿。

C3.speaker: YOU
C3.text: That sounds thoughtful. Please go ahead, and tell me if the beans change later today.
C3.zh: 聽起來很周到。就照這樣做；如果今天稍晚換了豆子，也請告訴我。

A1.speaker: COCO
A1.text: Welcome! Do you have a reservation?

A1.speaker: YOU
A1.text: Yes, I booked a room under Alex.
A1.zh: 有，我用 Alex 的名字訂了房。

A1.speaker: COCO
A1.text: May I see your ID, please?
A1.zh: 可以給我看一下你的證件嗎？

A1.speaker: YOU
A1.text: Of course. Here it is.

A1.speaker: COCO
A1.text: Your room is on the fifth floor. Do you need help with your bags?
A1.zh: 你的房間在五樓。需要幫忙拿行李嗎？

A1.speaker: YOU
A1.text: No, thank you. What time is breakfast?

A1.speaker: COCO
A1.text: Breakfast starts at seven in the morning.

A2.speaker: COCO
A2.text: Welcome to our hotel. Are you checking in today?
A2.zh: 歡迎來到我們的旅館。你今天要辦理入住嗎？

A2.speaker: YOU
A2.text: Yes. I have a room for two nights.
A2.zh: 是的，我訂了兩晚的房間。

A2.speaker: COCO
A2.text: May I have your name and an ID, please?
A2.zh: 請問可以提供你的姓名與證件嗎？

A2.speaker: YOU
A2.text: My name is Alex. Here is my passport.
A2.zh: 我叫 Alex。這是我的護照。

A3.speaker: COCO
A3.text: Your room is ready, and check-out is at eleven.
A3.zh: 你的房間準備好了，退房時間是十一點。

A3.speaker: YOU
A3.text: Thank you. Is breakfast included in my booking?
A3.zh: 謝謝。我的訂房有包含早餐嗎？

A3.speaker: COCO
A3.text: Yes. Breakfast is served downstairs from seven to ten.
A3.zh: 有。早餐在樓下供應，時間是七點到十點。

A3.speaker: YOU
A3.text: Perfect. Could you tell me where the elevator is?
A3.zh: 太好了。可以告訴我電梯在哪裡嗎？

B1.speaker: COCO
B1.text: I found your booking, but the room is not ready yet.
B1.zh: 我找到你的訂房了，不過房間還沒準備好。

B1.speaker: YOU
B1.text: I understand. I arrived early because my flight landed this morning.
B1.zh: 我了解。我提早到了，因為班機今天早上就降落。

B1.speaker: COCO
B1.text: You may leave your luggage here while you wait.
B1.zh: 等候時，你可以把行李寄放在這裡。

B1.speaker: YOU
B1.text: Thanks. Could you let me know when the room is available?
B1.zh: 謝謝。房間準備好時可以通知我嗎？

B2.speaker: COCO
B2.text: Your reservation includes a standard room, though a quieter room is available.
B2.zh: 你訂的是標準房，不過目前有比較安靜的房間。

B2.speaker: YOU
B2.text: That sounds useful. Would changing rooms affect the price or check-out time?
B2.zh: 聽起來不錯。換房會影響價格或退房時間嗎？

B2.speaker: COCO
B2.text: The price is the same, but the quieter room has one smaller window.
B2.zh: 價格一樣，但比較安靜的房間窗戶較小。

B2.speaker: YOU
B2.text: I value quiet more than the view, so I would like that room.
B2.zh: 比起景觀，我更重視安靜，所以想選那間。

B3.speaker: COCO
B3.text: I am sorry, but the air conditioning in your assigned room needs repair.
B3.zh: 抱歉，你原本分配的房間空調需要維修。

B3.speaker: YOU
B3.text: I need a quiet room for a video meeting tonight. What alternatives do you have?
B3.zh: 我今晚要開視訊會議，需要安靜的房間。還有哪些選擇？

B3.speaker: COCO
B3.text: We can move you to a room on another floor at no extra charge.
B3.zh: 我們可以免費幫你換到其他樓層的房間。

B3.speaker: YOU
B3.text: That would help. Please confirm the Wi-Fi is stable before I move.
B3.zh: 那會有幫助。換房前，請先確認 Wi-Fi 穩定。

C1.speaker: COCO
C1.text: The room you booked faces the street, but I can offer a courtyard room instead.
C1.zh: 你預訂的房間面向街道，但我可以改提供面向中庭的房間。

C1.speaker: YOU
C1.text: I have an early call tomorrow, so a quieter room would be worth a slightly smaller space.
C1.zh: 我明天一早有電話會議，因此房間小一點也值得換取安靜。

C1.speaker: COCO
C1.text: The courtyard room is available now and carries no additional fee.
C1.zh: 中庭房現在就能入住，而且不需額外費用。

C1.speaker: YOU
C1.text: Please switch my booking, and could you confirm the new room number in writing?
C1.zh: 請幫我更改訂房，也請用文字確認新的房號。

C2.speaker: COCO
C2.text: The city-wide conference has left us with fewer rooms than expected tonight.
C2.zh: 今晚全市舉辦會議，讓我們可提供的房間比預期少。

C2.speaker: YOU
C2.text: My confirmed reservation includes a desk and reliable internet, both of which I need for work.
C2.zh: 我已確認的訂房包含書桌和穩定網路，而這兩項都是工作必需。

C2.speaker: COCO
C2.text: I can arrange a comparable room at our sister property and cover the transfer.
C2.zh: 我可以安排你入住我們的姊妹旅館，提供相近房型，並支付交通費。

C2.speaker: YOU
C2.text: Please send me the room details first so I can confirm it meets those requirements.
C2.zh: 請先把房間資訊傳給我，好讓我確認是否符合這些需求。

C3.speaker: COCO
C3.text: There is a discrepancy between your confirmation and our system: the breakfast benefit is missing from the room record.
C3.zh: 你的確認信與我們的系統資料有出入：房間紀錄裡少了早餐權益。

C3.speaker: YOU
C3.text: I have the confirmation here. Could we resolve that before check-in so it does not become an issue tomorrow morning?
C3.zh: 我有確認信。能否在入住前處理好，避免明早又發生問題？

C3.speaker: COCO
C3.text: Of course. I will add a note to the booking, issue breakfast vouchers, and email the corrected details.
C3.zh: 當然。我會在訂房加註、發早餐券，並寄送更正後的資訊。

C3.speaker: YOU
C3.text: Thank you. Once the updated confirmation arrives, I will check that the dates and benefits are both correct.
C3.zh: 謝謝。收到更新的確認信後，我會核對日期與權益是否都正確。

A1.speaker: COCO
A1.text: Welcome. Do you need a table?

A1.speaker: YOU
A1.text: Yes, a table for two, please.

A1.speaker: COCO
A1.text: Please follow me.

A2.speaker: COCO
A2.text: Here is the menu. Would you like some water?
A2.zh: 這是菜單。你想喝點水嗎？

A2.speaker: YOU
A2.text: Yes, please. What is popular here?
A2.zh: 好，謝謝。這裡什麼餐點受歡迎？

A2.speaker: COCO
A2.text: The chicken rice is very popular.
A2.zh: 雞肉飯很受歡迎。

A3.speaker: COCO
A3.text: Our lunch special comes with soup. It is ready in ten minutes.
A3.zh: 午餐特餐有附湯，約十分鐘後會做好。

A3.speaker: YOU
A3.text: Does the soup have milk? I cannot have dairy.
A3.zh: 湯裡有牛奶嗎？我不能吃乳製品。

A3.speaker: COCO
A3.text: It does. I can offer a salad instead.
A3.zh: 有。我可以幫你換成沙拉。

B1.speaker: COCO
B1.text: Would you like a recommendation from our vegetarian dishes?
B1.zh: 要我推薦素食餐點嗎？

B1.speaker: YOU
B1.text: Yes. I prefer something filling because I skipped breakfast.
B1.zh: 好。我沒吃早餐，想要比較有飽足感的餐點。

B1.speaker: COCO
B1.text: The mushroom pasta is hearty and comes with a side salad.
B1.zh: 蘑菇義大利麵很有飽足感，還附一份沙拉。

B2.speaker: COCO
B2.text: The set meal includes fries, but you may replace them with vegetables.
B2.zh: 套餐附薯條，但可以換成蔬菜。

B2.speaker: YOU
B2.text: Could I make that substitution and split the bill with my friend?
B2.zh: 我可以換成蔬菜，並和朋友分開結帳嗎？

B2.speaker: COCO
B2.text: Certainly. I will note the change and prepare separate bills.
B2.zh: 當然。我會註明更換內容，並分開開立帳單。

B3.speaker: COCO
B3.text: I apologize; your main course is taking longer than we expected.
B3.zh: 抱歉，你的主餐比預期更久才會做好。

B3.speaker: YOU
B3.text: We have a show to catch. Could you estimate the wait or suggest a quicker dish?
B3.zh: 我們等一下要看表演。能否估計還要等多久，或推薦較快的餐點？

B3.speaker: COCO
B3.text: It will be another fifteen minutes; the soup and sandwich can be ready sooner.
B3.zh: 還要十五分鐘；湯和三明治可以更快上桌。

C1.speaker: COCO
C1.text: The tasting menu offers more variety, while the main course gives you a larger portion.
C1.zh: 品嚐套餐變化較多，單點主餐的份量則比較大。

C1.speaker: YOU
C1.text: I value variety, but I have limited time. How long does the tasting menu usually take?
C1.zh: 我喜歡多樣化，但時間有限。品嚐套餐通常需要多久？

C1.speaker: COCO
C1.text: Allow about an hour; I can serve the courses closer together if that helps.
C1.zh: 大約一小時；如果有幫助，我可以縮短每道菜之間的間隔。

C2.speaker: COCO
C2.text: I understand the dish was not prepared as you requested. How can we put that right?
C2.zh: 我了解這道菜沒有依照你的要求製作。我們該如何補救？

C2.speaker: YOU
C2.text: I appreciate your help. A corrected dish would be ideal, provided it can arrive before we leave.
C2.zh: 謝謝你願意協助。如果能在我們離開前送來，重新做一份最理想。

C2.speaker: COCO
C2.text: I will confirm the timing with the kitchen and return with a clear answer.
C2.zh: 我會向廚房確認時間，再給你明確的答覆。

C3.speaker: COCO
C3.text: The chef can adapt the dish, but the sauce is prepared in a shared kitchen area.
C3.zh: 主廚可以調整這道菜，但醬汁是在共用的廚房區域製作。

C3.speaker: YOU
C3.text: Because of a serious food allergy, I would rather choose an option you can prepare without that sauce or shared utensils.
C3.zh: 我有嚴重的食物過敏，寧可選一道能避開該醬汁與共用器具製作的餐點。

C3.speaker: COCO
C3.text: Thank you for explaining. I will check the preparation process directly with the chef before taking your order.
C3.zh: 謝謝你說明。我會先直接向主廚確認製作流程，再替你點餐。

A1.speaker: COCO
A1.text: Hello. What size do you need?

A1.speaker: YOU
A1.text: I need a medium, please.

A1.speaker: COCO
A1.text: Here is a medium.

A2.speaker: COCO
A2.text: This shirt comes in blue and green.
A2.zh: 這件上衣有藍色和綠色。

A2.speaker: YOU
A2.text: May I see the blue one?
A2.zh: 可以讓我看看藍色的嗎？

A2.speaker: COCO
A2.text: Of course. The fitting room is over there.
A2.zh: 當然可以。試衣間在那邊。

A3.speaker: COCO
A3.text: How does the jacket fit around your shoulders?
A3.zh: 這件外套的肩膀穿起來如何？

A3.speaker: YOU
A3.text: It feels a little tight. Do you have a larger size?
A3.zh: 有點緊。你們有大一號的嗎？

A3.speaker: COCO
A3.text: Yes, I will bring it to the fitting room.
A3.zh: 有，我會拿到試衣間給你。

B1.speaker: COCO
B1.text: You can exchange unworn items within fourteen days if you keep the receipt.
B1.zh: 未穿過的商品，保留收據可在十四天內換貨。

B1.speaker: YOU
B1.text: I am buying this as a gift. Can the recipient exchange the size?
B1.zh: 這是我要送人的禮物。收禮人可以換尺寸嗎？

B1.speaker: COCO
B1.text: Yes. I can include a gift receipt without the price.
B1.zh: 可以。我可以附上不顯示價格的禮物收據。

B2.speaker: COCO
B2.text: The sale price applies only to the colors displayed on this rack.
B2.zh: 特價只適用於這個衣架上展示的顏色。

B2.speaker: YOU
B2.text: If the navy version is full price, could you check whether another branch has the sale color in my size?
B2.zh: 如果深藍色是原價，可以幫我查別家分店有沒有我的尺寸和特價色嗎？

B2.speaker: COCO
B2.text: Certainly. I can search nearby stores and reserve one if it is available.
B2.zh: 當然。我可以查附近分店；有貨的話也能幫你保留。

B3.speaker: COCO
B3.text: I see the zipper is faulty, even though you bought the jacket yesterday.
B3.zh: 我看到拉鍊有瑕疵，雖然你昨天才買這件外套。

B3.speaker: YOU
B3.text: Could I exchange it for the same style rather than request a refund?
B3.zh: 我可以換同款，不申請退款嗎？

B3.speaker: COCO
B3.text: Yes. I will check our stock and inspect the replacement with you.
B3.zh: 可以。我會查庫存，並和你一起檢查換給你的商品。

C1.speaker: COCO
C1.text: This coat is lighter, whereas the other one is more durable in heavy rain.
C1.zh: 這件大衣較輕；另一件在大雨中更耐用。

C1.speaker: YOU
C1.text: I travel often, so I would accept a little extra weight if the fabric holds up better.
C1.zh: 我常旅行，所以如果布料更耐用，重一點也可以接受。

C1.speaker: COCO
C1.text: In that case, the weather-resistant model is probably the better investment.
C1.zh: 這樣的話，防風雨款可能是比較好的選擇。

C2.speaker: COCO
C2.text: We can order your size online, but delivery will be after your trip.
C2.zh: 我們可以在線上訂你的尺寸，但會在你旅行結束後才送達。

C2.speaker: YOU
C2.text: Could you compare in-store pickup at another branch with home delivery, including any fees?
C2.zh: 可以比較到其他分店取貨和宅配的時間及費用嗎？

C2.speaker: COCO
C2.text: I will check both options and let you decide once the dates are confirmed.
C2.zh: 我會查兩種方式，日期確認後再讓你決定。

C3.speaker: COCO
C3.text: The label mentions recycled fibers, but it does not specify how the garment was manufactured.
C3.zh: 標籤提到再生纖維，但沒有說明這件衣服的製造方式。

C3.speaker: YOU
C3.text: I like the design, yet I would prefer to review the sourcing details and return terms before committing.
C3.zh: 我喜歡設計，但在購買前想先了解原料來源與退貨條件。

C3.speaker: COCO
C3.text: That is fair. I can show you the product information and explain exactly which claims we can verify.
C3.zh: 這很合理。我可以提供商品資訊，並說明哪些說法有資料可查證。

A1.speaker: COCO
A1.text: Hi! I am Coco. What is your name?
A1.zh: 嗨！我是 Coco。你叫什麼名字？

A1.speaker: YOU
A1.text: I am Alex. Nice to meet you.
A1.zh: 我是 Alex。很高興認識你。

A1.speaker: COCO
A1.text: Nice to meet you, too!

A2.speaker: COCO
A2.text: Do you live near this park?
A2.zh: 你住在這座公園附近嗎？

A2.speaker: YOU
A2.text: Yes, I live a few streets away. How about you?
A2.zh: 對，我住在幾條街外。你呢？

A2.speaker: COCO
A2.text: I work nearby, so I come here after lunch.
A2.zh: 我在附近工作，所以午餐後常來。

A3.speaker: COCO
A3.text: What do you usually do on weekends?
A3.zh: 你週末通常做什麼？

A3.speaker: YOU
A3.text: I like to visit bookstores and try new cafés.
A3.zh: 我喜歡逛書店，也會試試新的咖啡店。

A3.speaker: COCO
A3.text: That sounds fun. There is a great bookstore near here.
A3.zh: 聽起來很有趣。這附近有一家很棒的書店。

B1.speaker: COCO
B1.text: I noticed you were reading about photography. Is that a hobby of yours?
B1.zh: 我看到你在讀攝影相關的書。攝影是你的興趣嗎？

B1.speaker: YOU
B1.text: Yes. I started last year because I wanted to capture my travels.
B1.zh: 是的。我去年開始學，因為想記錄旅行。

B1.speaker: COCO
B1.text: I enjoy it too. What kind of places do you like to photograph?
B1.zh: 我也喜歡。你喜歡拍什麼樣的地方？

B2.speaker: COCO
B2.text: A few of us are visiting the weekend market. Would you like to join?
B2.zh: 我們幾個人週末要去逛市集。你想一起來嗎？

B2.speaker: YOU
B2.text: I would like to, but I am busy in the morning. Could I meet you there later?
B2.zh: 我想去，但早上有事。我可以晚一點在那裡和你們會合嗎？

B2.speaker: COCO
B2.text: Of course. I will send you the location and our rough plan.
B2.zh: 當然。我會把地點和大致行程傳給你。

B3.speaker: COCO
B3.text: I am still learning the local customs, so I sometimes worry about saying the wrong thing.
B3.zh: 我還在學習這裡的習慣，有時會擔心說錯話。

B3.speaker: YOU
B3.text: I understand. If something sounds unusual, please tell me and I will be happy to learn.
B3.zh: 我懂。如果我說了什麼不太合適的話，請告訴我，我很願意學。

B3.speaker: COCO
B3.text: That is kind of you. A relaxed conversation helps a lot.
B3.zh: 你真貼心。輕鬆聊聊就很有幫助。

C1.speaker: COCO
C1.text: You mentioned changing careers. What has surprised you most about the new field?
C1.zh: 你提過轉換跑道。新領域最讓你意外的是什麼？

C1.speaker: YOU
C1.text: The pace is faster than I expected, but I have enjoyed learning from people with different backgrounds.
C1.zh: 節奏比我預期快，但我很享受向不同背景的人學習。

C1.speaker: COCO
C1.text: That mix of perspectives can make the work much more interesting.
C1.zh: 不同觀點的交流確實能讓工作更有趣。

C2.speaker: COCO
C2.text: We are planning a small gathering on Friday, though I know it is a busy week for you.
C2.zh: 我們打算週五小聚一下，但我知道你這週很忙。

C2.speaker: YOU
C2.text: Thanks for thinking of me. I cannot promise yet; would it be all right if I let you know tomorrow?
C2.zh: 謝謝你想到我。我還無法確定；明天再回覆你可以嗎？

C2.speaker: COCO
C2.text: Absolutely. There is no pressure, and you are welcome whenever it works.
C2.zh: 當然，沒有壓力；時間合適的話，隨時歡迎你來。

C3.speaker: COCO
C3.text: Our conversation about travel made me realize we value different kinds of experiences.
C3.zh: 我們聊旅行時，我發現我們重視的體驗類型不太一樣。

C3.speaker: YOU
C3.text: That is true. I am drawn to unplanned moments, while you seem to enjoy understanding a place in depth.
C3.zh: 確實如此。我喜歡沒有安排的驚喜，而你似乎喜歡深入了解一個地方。

C3.speaker: COCO
C3.text: Exactly. Perhaps the best trip would leave room for both curiosity and a little structure.
C3.zh: 正是如此。也許最好的旅行，是同時保留探索空間和一點規劃。

A1.speaker: COCO
A1.text: Hello. Do you have an appointment?

A1.speaker: YOU
A1.text: Yes, at three o’clock.

A1.speaker: COCO
A1.text: Please check in at the desk.

A2.speaker: COCO
A2.text: The doctor has an opening on Tuesday morning.
A2.zh: 醫師週二上午有空檔。

A2.speaker: YOU
A2.text: Could I come in the afternoon instead?
A2.zh: 我可以改成下午來嗎？

A2.speaker: COCO
A2.text: Yes, there is a time at two thirty.
A2.zh: 可以，兩點半有空檔。

A3.speaker: COCO
A3.text: What would you like to discuss at the appointment?
A3.zh: 這次預約想和醫師討論什麼？

A3.speaker: YOU
A3.text: I have had a headache since yesterday.
A3.zh: 我從昨天開始頭痛。

A3.speaker: COCO
A3.text: I will note that for the clinician.
A3.zh: 我會幫你記錄，提供給醫護人員。

B1.speaker: COCO
B1.text: We can book a routine appointment for Thursday. Does that work?
B1.zh: 我們可以預約週四的一般門診。這時間可以嗎？

B1.speaker: YOU
B1.text: Yes. I would like to discuss a cough that has lasted about a week.
B1.zh: 可以。我想談談持續大約一週的咳嗽。

B1.speaker: COCO
B1.text: I will add that to the appointment note.
B1.zh: 我會把這點加在預約備註裡。

B2.speaker: COCO
B2.text: Would you prefer an in-person visit or a video appointment?
B2.zh: 你比較想現場看診，還是視訊看診？

B2.speaker: YOU
B2.text: I would prefer to come in. Could you confirm the address and check-in time?
B2.zh: 我比較想現場看診。可以確認地址和報到時間嗎？

B2.speaker: COCO
B2.text: Certainly. Please arrive ten minutes early at our main clinic.
B2.zh: 當然。請提早十分鐘到我們的主診所。

B3.speaker: COCO
B3.text: Your appointment needs to move because the clinician is unavailable that day.
B3.zh: 醫護人員當天無法看診，因此你的預約需要改期。

B3.speaker: YOU
B3.text: Could you offer another time this week and keep my original appointment notes?
B3.zh: 這週還有其他時段嗎？原本的預約備註能保留嗎？

B3.speaker: COCO
B3.text: Yes. I will transfer the notes and send you the new confirmation.
B3.zh: 可以。我會轉移備註，並寄給你新的確認資訊。

C1.speaker: COCO
C1.text: Before your first visit, we need a short history form and a list of current medications.
C1.zh: 第一次看診前，我們需要簡短的病史表與目前用藥清單。

C1.speaker: YOU
C1.text: I can bring both. Could you clarify whether I should also bring previous test reports?
C1.zh: 兩項我都能帶。請問還需要帶以前的檢查報告嗎？

C1.speaker: COCO
C1.text: If you have them, please bring copies so the clinician can review the context.
C1.zh: 如果有，請帶副本，方便醫護人員了解先前情況。

C2.speaker: COCO
C2.text: We can arrange language assistance for the consultation if you would find that helpful.
C2.zh: 如果有需要，我們可以安排看診時的語言協助。

C2.speaker: YOU
C2.text: That would help me explain the timeline accurately. Is the assistance available for the whole visit?
C2.zh: 那有助於我準確說明症狀的時間經過。協助會涵蓋整段看診嗎？

C2.speaker: COCO
C2.text: I will check availability and confirm the arrangements before your appointment.
C2.zh: 我會確認人員是否可用，並在看診前通知你安排結果。

C3.speaker: COCO
C3.text: We can send the appointment summary electronically, but the contact preference on file may be outdated.
C3.zh: 我們可以用電子方式寄送看診摘要，但系統記錄的聯絡偏好可能已過期。

C3.speaker: YOU
C3.text: Before anything is sent, I would like to confirm the recipient address and how follow-up questions should be handled.
C3.zh: 寄出任何資料前，我想先確認收件地址，以及後續問題該如何聯繫。

C3.speaker: COCO
C3.text: Certainly. We will verify those details with you and explain the available follow-up channels.
C3.zh: 當然。我們會和你核對資料，並說明可用的後續聯絡管道。

A1.speaker: COCO
A1.text: Hi, Alex. Can you help me with this file?
A1.zh: 嗨，Alex。你可以幫我看這份檔案嗎？

A1.speaker: YOU
A1.text: Yes. Please send it to me.

A1.speaker: COCO
A1.text: Thanks. I will send it now.

A2.speaker: COCO
A2.text: Did you finish the first part of the report?
A2.zh: 報告的第一部分你完成了嗎？

A2.speaker: YOU
A2.text: Yes. I will share it this afternoon.
A2.zh: 完成了。我今天下午會分享。

A2.speaker: COCO
A2.text: Great. I can review it tomorrow.
A2.zh: 太好了。我明天可以看。

A3.speaker: COCO
A3.text: We need the updated chart before Friday.
A3.zh: 我們需要在週五前拿到更新的圖表。

A3.speaker: YOU
A3.text: I can finish it by Thursday if I get the data today.
A3.zh: 如果今天拿到資料，我週四前可以完成。

A3.speaker: COCO
A3.text: I will send the data after lunch.
A3.zh: 我午餐後會把資料傳給你。

B1.speaker: COCO
B1.text: How is the customer summary coming along?
B1.zh: 客戶摘要進度如何？

B1.speaker: YOU
B1.text: The main points are ready, but I am waiting for the latest sales figures.
B1.zh: 主要重點已整理好，但我還在等最新的銷售數字。

B1.speaker: COCO
B1.text: I can ask the sales team when those figures will be available.
B1.zh: 我可以向業務團隊確認數字何時會出來。

B2.speaker: COCO
B2.text: Two requests came in at once. Which should we handle first?
B2.zh: 有兩項需求同時進來。我們應該先處理哪一項？

B2.speaker: YOU
B2.text: The client update is due sooner, so I suggest we finish that before revising the slides.
B2.zh: 客戶更新比較快到期，所以我建議先完成它，再修改簡報。

B2.speaker: COCO
B2.text: Agreed. I will let the team know about the revised order.
B2.zh: 同意。我會告訴團隊新的處理順序。

B3.speaker: COCO
B3.text: I will be away tomorrow. Could you take over the supplier follow-up?
B3.zh: 我明天不在。你可以接手供應商的追蹤嗎？

B3.speaker: YOU
B3.text: I can, provided you send me the latest email thread and the open questions.
B3.zh: 可以，只要你把最新的郵件往來與待確認問題傳給我。

B3.speaker: COCO
B3.text: I will write a short handover so nothing gets missed.
B3.zh: 我會寫一份簡短交接，避免漏掉事情。

C1.speaker: COCO
C1.text: The request now includes a new analysis, although our original deadline has not moved.
C1.zh: 需求現在又增加一項分析，但原本的期限沒有延後。

C1.speaker: YOU
C1.text: We should clarify who owns the new work before promising the same delivery date.
C1.zh: 承諾維持原交期前，我們應該先釐清新增工作由誰負責。

C1.speaker: COCO
C1.text: I agree. Let us bring the scope change to the project lead.
C1.zh: 我同意。我們一起把範圍變更提出來和專案負責人討論。

C2.speaker: COCO
C2.text: If we spend another day polishing the visuals, the review team will have less time to check the numbers.
C2.zh: 如果再花一天修飾圖表，審查團隊核對數字的時間就會縮短。

C2.speaker: YOU
C2.text: I would prioritize accuracy, then refine the visuals once the figures have been signed off.
C2.zh: 我會先重視數字正確性；確認後再修飾圖表。

C2.speaker: COCO
C2.text: That seems sensible. I will adjust the schedule and explain the sequence.
C2.zh: 這樣很合理。我會調整時程並說明工作順序。

C3.speaker: COCO
C3.text: The data suggests progress, but the sample is too small for a confident conclusion.
C3.zh: 資料顯示有進展，但樣本太小，還不足以做出有把握的結論。

C3.speaker: YOU
C3.text: Let us present the trend as preliminary and specify what additional evidence we need before changing course.
C3.zh: 我們把趨勢列為初步觀察，並說明改變方向前還需要哪些證據。

C3.speaker: COCO
C3.text: Good. That communicates momentum without overstating what the numbers prove.
C3.zh: 好。這樣能呈現進度，也不會誇大數字能證明的事。

A1.speaker: COCO
A1.text: Let us start the meeting. Is everyone ready?
A1.zh: 我們開始開會吧。大家準備好了嗎？

A1.speaker: YOU
A1.text: Yes, I am ready.

A1.speaker: COCO
A1.text: Great. Here is today’s agenda.

A2.speaker: COCO
A2.text: Do you have an idea for the next step?
A2.zh: 你對下一步有想法嗎？

A2.speaker: YOU
A2.text: I think we should talk to the customer first.
A2.zh: 我認為我們應該先和客戶談。

A2.speaker: COCO
A2.text: Good idea. I will add that to our plan.
A2.zh: 好主意。我會把它加進計畫。

A3.speaker: COCO
A3.text: We need to make a decision by Friday.
A3.zh: 我們必須在週五前做決定。

A3.speaker: YOU
A3.text: Can we review the two options tomorrow morning?
A3.zh: 我們可以明天早上檢視兩個方案嗎？

A3.speaker: COCO
A3.text: Yes. I will send the details today.
A3.zh: 可以。我今天會把細節寄給你們。

B1.speaker: COCO
B1.text: What feedback did the team give on the first design?
B1.zh: 團隊對第一版設計有什麼意見？

B1.speaker: YOU
B1.text: They liked the layout, but several people found the instructions unclear.
B1.zh: 他們喜歡版面，但有幾個人覺得說明不夠清楚。

B1.speaker: COCO
B1.text: Then let us revise the instructions before testing again.
B1.zh: 那我們先修改說明，再重新測試。

B2.speaker: COCO
B2.text: We can improve speed or add more features, but not both this month.
B2.zh: 這個月我們可以改善速度，或增加功能，但無法兩者都做。

B2.speaker: YOU
B2.text: I would prioritize speed because users notice the delay in every session.
B2.zh: 我會先改善速度，因為使用者每次操作都會感受到延遲。

B2.speaker: COCO
B2.text: That is a clear reason. I will note the trade-off in the decision log.
B2.zh: 理由很清楚。我會把這項取捨記在決策紀錄中。

B3.speaker: COCO
B3.text: The requirements changed after testing, so the original plan no longer fits.
B3.zh: 測試後需求變了，原本的計畫已不適用。

B3.speaker: YOU
B3.text: Could we separate essential changes from ideas that can wait for a later release?
B3.zh: 我們可以把必要修改和可留到之後版本的構想分開嗎？

B3.speaker: COCO
B3.text: Yes. I will group the feedback and bring a revised scope tomorrow.
B3.zh: 可以。我會整理回饋，明天提出修訂後的範圍。

C1.speaker: COCO
C1.text: The latest numbers favor option A, though the difference is smaller than we expected.
C1.zh: 最新數字較支持 A 方案，但差距比預期小。

C1.speaker: YOU
C1.text: Before choosing, I would like to understand whether the result holds across different customer groups.
C1.zh: 做決定前，我想了解不同客群是否也呈現相同結果。

C1.speaker: COCO
C1.text: That is a useful check. We can break down the data and reconvene.
C1.zh: 這項檢查很有價值。我們可以拆分資料，再開會討論。

C2.speaker: COCO
C2.text: Operations supports the change, but support teams are concerned about the rollout timing.
C2.zh: 營運團隊支持變更，但客服團隊擔心推出時程。

C2.speaker: YOU
C2.text: Could we agree on a staged launch with clear ownership for customer communication?
C2.zh: 我們能否同意分階段推出，並明確指定客戶溝通的負責人？

C2.speaker: COCO
C2.text: I will ask both teams to review that proposal before we commit to a date.
C2.zh: 我會請兩個團隊先檢視這項提案，再決定日期。

C3.speaker: COCO
C3.text: We appear to agree on the goal, but we are using different assumptions about the cost of delay.
C3.zh: 我們似乎同意目標，但對延後的成本採用不同假設。

C3.speaker: YOU
C3.text: Rather than force a decision today, could we state those assumptions explicitly and test the most consequential one?
C3.zh: 與其今天硬做決定，我們能否明確列出假設，並驗證影響最大的一項？

C3.speaker: COCO
C3.text: Yes. That would make the disagreement concrete and give us a stronger basis for the next decision.
C3.zh: 可以。這能讓分歧具體化，也讓下一次決策有更扎實的依據。

A1.speaker: COCO
A1.text: Hello, this is Coco from the office.
A1.zh: 你好，我是辦公室的 Coco。

A1.speaker: YOU
A1.text: Hi, this is Alex.

A1.speaker: COCO
A1.text: Thanks for calling.

A2.speaker: COCO
A2.text: May I speak with Alex, please?
A2.zh: 請問可以找 Alex 嗎？

A2.speaker: YOU
A2.text: Alex is not here. Can I take a message?
A2.zh: Alex 不在。我可以幫你留言嗎？

A2.speaker: COCO
A2.text: Yes. Please ask Alex to call me back.
A2.zh: 好。請 Alex 回電給我。

A3.speaker: COCO
A3.text: I am calling about our meeting on Thursday.
A3.zh: 我打來是想談週四的會議。

A3.speaker: YOU
A3.text: Could we move it to three in the afternoon?
A3.zh: 可以改到下午三點嗎？

A3.speaker: COCO
A3.text: Let me check the calendar and call you back.
A3.zh: 我確認行事曆後再回電。

B1.speaker: COCO
B1.text: I wanted to confirm the delivery address before we send the samples.
B1.zh: 寄送樣品前，我想確認收件地址。

B1.speaker: YOU
B1.text: Please use the new office address. I can email it to you now.
B1.zh: 請用新的辦公室地址。我現在可以寄信給你。

B1.speaker: COCO
B1.text: That would help. I will read it back when I receive it.
B1.zh: 那會有幫助。收到後我會再唸一次，和你核對。

B2.speaker: COCO
B2.text: The team is free on Monday or Wednesday for a short call.
B2.zh: 團隊週一或週三有空，可以開個短會。

B2.speaker: YOU
B2.text: Wednesday works better. Could you send an invitation with the topics to cover?
B2.zh: 週三比較適合。可以寄會議邀請，附上要討論的主題嗎？

B2.speaker: COCO
B2.text: Of course. I will include a twenty-minute agenda.
B2.zh: 當然。我會附上一份二十分鐘的議程。

B3.speaker: COCO
B3.text: I am following up because we have not received the revised document yet.
B3.zh: 我來追蹤一下，因為我們還沒收到修訂後的文件。

B3.speaker: YOU
B3.text: I sent it earlier, but I may have used the old address. Could I confirm your email?
B3.zh: 我早些時候寄了，但可能用了舊地址。可以確認你的電子郵件嗎？

B3.speaker: COCO
B3.text: Yes. I will spell it out, and please resend the file after the call.
B3.zh: 可以。我會拼給你聽，通話後請再寄一次。

C1.speaker: COCO
C1.text: Before we discuss the customer details, can you confirm who else is on the line?
C1.zh: 討論客戶細節前，可以確認還有誰在線上嗎？

C1.speaker: YOU
C1.text: It is just me. If we need to involve others, I will first check what information we may share.
C1.zh: 只有我。如果需要找其他人，我會先確認哪些資訊可以分享。

C1.speaker: COCO
C1.text: Thank you. Let us start with the general timeline rather than personal data.
C1.zh: 謝謝。我們先談一般時程，暫不涉及個人資料。

C2.speaker: COCO
C2.text: I heard that the launch date has shifted, though the email did not explain whether the scope changed.
C2.zh: 我聽說上市日期調整了，但郵件沒有說明範圍是否也變了。

C2.speaker: YOU
C2.text: That is worth clarifying. My understanding is the scope is unchanged, but I will confirm before we update the schedule.
C2.zh: 這點值得釐清。我的理解是範圍不變，但更新時程前我會再確認。

C2.speaker: COCO
C2.text: Please send a short written summary afterward so both teams use the same assumptions.
C2.zh: 之後請寄一份簡短書面摘要，讓兩邊團隊採用相同假設。

C3.speaker: COCO
C3.text: We can tentatively reserve capacity, but I cannot guarantee delivery until the final requirements are approved.
C3.zh: 我們可以先暫留產能，但在最終需求核准前，我無法保證交付。

C3.speaker: YOU
C3.text: That distinction is helpful. Could we document what is provisional and what must be confirmed by Friday?
C3.zh: 這樣區分很有幫助。我們能否記錄哪些是暫定事項、哪些必須在週五前確認？

C3.speaker: COCO
C3.text: Absolutely. I will circulate a summary that keeps the tentative plan separate from firm commitments.
C3.zh: 當然。我會發送摘要，清楚區分暫定計畫與確定承諾。
